analytics_collectors.label: Analytics collectors
analytics_collectors.help_text: The analytics collectors registered on this installation, keyed by collector name.

analytics_status.label: Analytics status
analytics_status.help_text: Whether analytics gathering is turned on.

become_methods.label: Become methods
become_methods.help_text: The privilege escalation methods AWX accepts, as value and label pairs.

custom_virtualenvs.label: Custom virtualenvs
custom_virtualenvs.help_text: Paths of the virtual environments left over from before execution environments. AWX treats these as deprecated.

eula.label: EULA
eula.help_text: The end user license agreement text. Empty on an open installation.

license_info.label: License info
license_info.help_text: Subscription details, including license type, expiry and the host counts it permits.

project_base_dir.label: Project base dir
project_base_dir.help_text: Filesystem path the installation stores project checkouts under.

project_local_paths.label: Project local paths
project_local_paths.help_text: Directories under the project base dir that a manual project can be pointed at.

time_zone.label: Time zone
time_zone.help_text: The time zone the installation runs in, which schedules are evaluated against.

ui_next.label: UI next
ui_next.help_text: Whether this installation serves the next generation user interface.

version.label: Version
version.help_text: The AWX version this installation runs, which is not necessarily the version the provider was generated against.

namespace.description: The namespace to which the resource belongs to

active_node.label: Active node
active_node.help_text: Hostname of the node that answered this request.

ha.label: HA
ha.help_text: Whether the installation runs more than one node.

install_uuid.label: Install UUID
install_uuid.help_text: Identifier unique to this installation, stable across restarts.

instance_groups.label: Instance groups
instance_groups.help_text: The instance groups in the mesh, each with its capacity and member nodes. Capacity shifts as jobs run, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.

instances.label: Instances
instances.help_text: The nodes in the mesh, each with its type, capacity and last heartbeat. Heartbeats move on their own, so a config that reads this diffs on every plan.

version.label: Version
version.help_text: The AWX version this installation runs, which is not necessarily the version the provider was generated against.

wait_lifecycle.wait_description: If true, wait for AWX to finish the SCM update kicked off on create or update before returning. Configure the maximum wait via the timeouts block.

TOWER_URL_BASE.help_text: This setting is used by services like notifications to render a valid url to the service.
TOWER_URL_BASE.label: Base URL of the service

workflow_job_template_node_id.label: Workflow job template node
workflow_job_template_node_id.help_text: Database ID of the workflow job template node to convert into an approval.
